task-1774975756603-xaxgcp.description: Add `message` config field to the Limit plugin in pingap-plugin/src/limit.rs. When set, this custom message replaces the default "Plugin limit, exceed limit {value}/{max}" error text in HTTP 429 responses. Follow the existing pattern from ip_restriction.rs, ua_restriction.rs, referer_restriction.rs which already support `message` field via get_str_conf. Changes needed: 1) Add `message: String` field to Limiter struct. 2) Parse it with get_str_conf(value, "message") in Limiter::new(). 3) In handle_request, use self.message instead of e.to_string() when message is non-empty. 4) Update conf/plugins.toml docs with message example. 5) Add test for custom message.
